title: Legendary Upgrades
description: A mod That Brings More Upgrade to the already existing Set of Armor, the Armor in this mod is a Huge Step Up to the Normal Netherite
body:
**Important Use Version 1.7.1 & Above instead of the older version.**

This mod added an Upgrade from the regular Netherite that means the Armor are stronger better than netherite with Ability and More to Minecraft. 

**"Video Showcase Coming Soon"**

This mod is a stand alone mod based on Material Upgrade that have a few material like Cryolume material, that is based around the Glow Squid and a new material Syphorium, that is based on The End. 

Mod Developer:
Yobonari Team 
Sunnie Paws (Mod CEO & Developer)
